title: Finite branch-relative Jacobian/entropy compensator interface
question: What exact finite branch-relative lower-bound budget follows when a later owner supplies an injective chart, positive Jacobian lower bound, active/normal side lengths, and an energy ceiling?
method: Keep the existing A1/A6/A7 fixed-floor functional, T-054 forward owner order, T-059/T-061 observation-first locks, and every promotion firewall unchanged.
Reuse the R-464 sextic comparison, R-465 radial partition upper envelope, and R-466 positive-volume tube interface as conditional inputs only.
Apply the measurable change-of-variables lower bound with active dimension k_N, normal dimension n_N, chart volume s_a,N^k_N*s_n,N^n_N, and Jacobian lower bound J_N.
Separate the logarithmic Jacobian/entropy term, Boltzmann ceiling, and comparison normalization, then define the reference-relative compensator.
Audit owner-neutral fixtures through primary, independent, hostile, integrated, and Lean lanes; issue no intermediate PDF.
decision_scope: T0 finite conditional branch-relative Jacobian/entropy budget; no source-owned chart, uniform branch probability, entropy density, tightness, continuum, physical, QFT, Yang--Mills, or mass-gap inference
finding: For every declared finite cutoff and beta, a positive chart Jacobian and active/normal box volume give mu_N(Phi_N(U_N)) >= J_N*vol(U_N)*exp(-beta*E_N)/Z_upper_N(beta). The logarithmic budget separates chart entropy, Jacobian, Boltzmann ceiling, and comparison normalization; its finite fixture rows decrease with cutoff, so a later source-owned uniform compensator remains necessary.
decision_reason: R-467 is the next nonredundant conditional interface named by R-466. It makes the branch-relative entropy/Jacobian prerequisite testable without inventing a branch or changing the established methods.
boundary: The chart, Jacobian, sides, and ceiling are owner-neutral fixtures. No source-owned active embedding, actual correlated partition, uniform compensator, branch probability, entropy density, tightness, floor removal, ordered limit, continuum, physical branch, Pre-A, Sector A, QFT, Yang--Mills, or mass-gap result follows.
